description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to X509 certificate handling using OpenSSL within the libwebsockets project. It includes certificate parsing, verification, extraction of certificate info, and conversion to JWK format, as well as some conditional platform-specific code.

classes.name: lws_x509_cert
classes.description: Struct representing an X509 certificate within the libwebsockets context, holding an OpenSSL X509 pointer.

methods.name: int lws_tls_openssl_cert_info(X509 * x509,enum lws_tls_cert_info type,union lws_tls_cert_info_results * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Extracts specific information from an X509 certificate based on the specified type, such as validity periods, common name, issuer name, usage, public key, or raw DER data.

methods.name: int lws_x509_info(struct lws_x509_cert * x509,enum lws_tls_cert_info type,union lws_tls_cert_info_results * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Wrapper for lws_tls_openssl_cert_info that operates on lws_x509_cert objects.

methods.name: int lws_tls_vhost_cert_info(struct lws_vhost * vhost,enum lws_tls_cert_info type,union lws_tls_cert_info_results * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Retrieves certificate info for a virtual host, if supported by the OpenSSL version.

methods.name: int lws_tls_peer_cert_info(struct lws * wsi,enum lws_tls_cert_info type,union lws_tls_cert_info_results * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Retrieves certificate info from the peer connection associated with a WebSocket instance.

methods.name: int lws_x509_create(struct lws_x509_cert ** x509)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new lws_x509_cert structure.

methods.name: int lws_x509_parse_from_pem(struct lws_x509_cert * x509,const void * pem,size_t len)
methods.description: Parses a PEM-encoded certificate buffer into an lws_x509_cert object.

methods.name: int lws_x509_verify(struct lws_x509_cert * x509,struct lws_x509_cert * trusted,const char * common_name)
methods.description: Verifies a certificate against trusted certificate and optional common name.

methods.name: int lws_x509_public_to_jwk(struct lws_jwk * jwk,struct lws_x509_cert * x509,const char * curves,int rsa_min_bits)
methods.description: Converts the public key from an X509 certificate into a JSON Web Key (JWK) format.

methods.name: int lws_x509_jwk_privkey_pem(struct lws_context * cx,struct lws_jwk * jwk,void * pem,size_t len,const char * passphrase)
methods.description: Loads a private key in PEM format into a JWK structure, optionally protected by a passphrase.

methods.name: void lws_x509_destroy(struct lws_x509_cert ** x509)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an lws_x509_cert object.

methods.name: int lws_x509_jwk_privkey_pem_pp_cb(char * buf,int size,int rwflag,void * u)
